question: Do the committed run packs, their attestations and the committed winners re-derive every PROMOTED_BY edge in docs/evidence/graph.json, and what does S1 still hold open?
answer: 47 of 47 PROMOTED_BY edges re-derive byte for byte from 184 packs (184 GameRuns, 0 lift failures); attested by agent:pedro-2026-09-27 47; custody complete 11, recovered 36. Open: 2 committed MODEL_ONLY winners no pack names (campaign-night1-minus7-winner.json, campaign-toys-night5-winner.json); UNTRACKED_WINNER_DEBT 1 of 1.
labels: A query over committed evidence: it measures nothing and promotes nothing. The edges it re-derives carry DEVICE_MEASURED claims already promoted; the open winners are MODEL_ONLY.

git.note: the query code is in the commit that adds this record

query.rule: an edge is derived for a pack when every packPromotionChecks check passes, derivePromotion re-derives every check and names the claim, and the pack attestation lists exactly the checks, inputs, claim and custody derived now; the edge is recordPromotion's over that pack, and it matches when graph.json holds the same edge (canonical JSON)

modelOnlyWinners.rule: a committed winner-v1 binding none of whose hashes (its stableHash, and the winnerHash a bundle compiled from it records) any run pack names: it has never been shown on the phone by a pack, so it stands MODEL_ONLY

untrackedWinnerDebt.rule: a registered anchor binding (ANCHOR_AIMS) with no committed tools/device/*-winner.json of the same stableHash, against the closed UNTRACKED_WINNER_DEBT list

entries.note: night 6 a: found 2026-09-25 at artifacts/night6-anchored/bundle/winner.json with this stableHash, but not committable: it no longer rebuilds (winner.gate.replayHash does not match the candidate replay under the current engine), which test-winners-rebuild.mjs refuses by design
